description: CSR Sparse Matrix-Vector Multiply (SpMV) benchmark using cuSPARSE (NVIDIA) or rocSPARSE (AMD). Computes y = A * x where A is a synthetic CSR sparse matrix with a fixed number of non-zeros per row. Reports both GB/s and GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: num_rows
scaling_param.description: Number of rows (and columns) in the square sparse matrix

non_scaling_params.name: nnz_per_row
non_scaling_params.description: Number of non-zero elements per row; controls sparsity pattern

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warmup iterations before timing

non_scaling_params.name: iters
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations for averaging
